conventions.title: Never flush production Redis
conventions.text: On-call rule: never run FLUSHALL or FLUSHDB on dispatch-cache or any production Redis. dispatch-cache holds live rider assignments and surge-pricing state; flushing it re-assigns every in-flight order. Use scripts/purge_stale_rider_keys.py for targeted cleanup. Established after INC-2199.

conventions.title: RDS instance class changes need IC approval
conventions.text: On-call rule: changing an RDS instance class (e.g. orders-db) during an incident triggers a Multi-AZ failover with 60-120 seconds of full database downtime. It requires explicit incident-commander approval. Established after INC-2282.

conventions.title: orders-db connection budget
conventions.text: On-call rule: orders-db has max_connections=500. checkout-api pods each use a HikariCP pool of up to 40 connections, so scaling checkout-api above 12 replicas can exhaust the database for every service. Do not scale checkout-api to fix pool exhaustion without checking the budget (see INC-2104).

conventions.title: PSP failover is pre-approved
conventions.text: On-call rule: flipping the Flagship flag upi_psp_routing to 'upixpress:100' is pre-approved for any on-call engineer when NovaPay UPI success drops below 90%. Post in #psp-novapay-bridge and page Kavya Reddy. Do not run the payment-retry job while a PSP is degraded (see INC-2233).

conventions.title: Kafka poison records
conventions.text:
On-call rule: to unblock a Kafka partition stuck on a poison record, move the single offset to the DLQ with kafka-dlq-skip --topic --partition

--offset --to-dlq. Never reset consumer group offsets to latest on inventory.updates; it silently loses stock updates.

conventions.title: Rollbacks via Argo CD
conventions.text: On-call rule: roll back an application with argocd app history <app> followed by argocd app rollback <app> <revision>. Rollbacks of the last deploy are pre-approved during an incident if the deploy happened within 6 hours of the alert.

changes.summary: inventory-sync v3.8.0 deployed: inventory-reconcile CronJob schedule changed from '0 3 * * *' to '30 5 * * *' (author assumed the cluster runs in IST; CronJobs run in UTC, so it now fires at 11:00 IST).
Terraform IAM refactor (infra PR #1187) tightened the cert-manager IRSA role policy; route53:ChangeResourceRecordSets on the basketbolt.in hosted zone was removed by mistake.
rider-dispatch v2.4.0 deployed: rider location writes moved to a GEOADD pipeline; the EXPIRE call for rider:loc:{rider_id} keys was dropped.
search-api v7.2.0: 'filter chips' feature launched behind flag search_filter_chips at 50% traffic (terms aggregations on brand.keyword and attributes.*).
notification-svc v3.9.0: OTP SMS copy changed to include the app name and an emoji (template_version v8).
Warehouse HYD-KONDAPUR-02 WMS firmware updated to 5.2 by the vendor (bundled-item SKU encoding changed).
Platform CronJob clean-up: all CronJobs now declare timeZone: Asia/Kolkata. Several jobs were normalised to '0 0 * * *'.
EKS upgrade 1.31 -> 1.32 using a new node group ng-general-v4 (old node group ng-general-v3 drained).
checkout-api v5.12.0 deployed: datasource config moved into shared library bb-spring-starter 2.3.
Quarterly rotation of the UPIxpress webhook signing secret (Vault path secret/payments/upixpress/webhook, key id whsec_2026_09).
